feat(fixer): Daytona sandbox client + credentials (WAT-66) (#35)

* feat(fixer): Daytona sandbox client + credentials (WAT-66)

Injectable @daytona/sdk wrapper (provision/start/statusRead/destroy) for the
autonomous-fixer sandbox, plus per-workspace Daytona API-key storage and a
draft sandbox image.

- src/integrations/daytona-client.js — factory-injectable client; maps the
  grilled run-bound/teardown decisions onto the SDK (autoStop/autoDelete
  intervals, snapshot image, env injection). statusRead classifies the real
  SandboxState enum terminal-vs-running for the poller backstop (decision 05);
  destroy is idempotent on DaytonaNotFoundError. SDK contract verified against
  the installed @daytona/sdk@0.187.0, not just docs.
- workspace-registry: migration v6 + updateDaytonaCredentials/getDaytonaCredentials
  (API key AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest, mirrors WAT-65).
- add-daytona-credentials.js — one-time registration script.
- fixer-sandbox/ — DRAFT image (Dockerfile + README); blocked on the WAT-67
  wrapper entrypoint + operator Daytona account/registry.

Tests: 27 new (21 client + 6 registry round-trip); full suite 1746 green.
Image build + real Daytona path deferred to staging (WAT-71).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(fixer): address code-review findings on daytona-client (WAT-66)

- destroy(): drop the /not found/i message-regex arm — it masked a live
  sandbox behind any unrelated error containing "not found" (orphan/billing
  leak). Match only DaytonaNotFoundError by name + 404 statusCode.
- provision(): return ok:true ONLY with a truthy sandboxId AND a non-terminal
  state; add the `terminal` field so the result shape matches statusRead()
  (a fresh provision into error/build_failed no longer reads as dispatching-ready).
- provision(): throw on missing snapshot, consistent with start/statusRead/
  destroy and the file header's "missing required args throw" contract.
- all ops: normalise catch detail via errMessage() (non-Error throws no longer
  log/return `undefined`), mirroring the add-*-credentials describeError helper.
- isTerminalState: add a separate exhaustiveness test that imports the real
  @daytona/sdk SandboxState enum and fails if the SDK adds a state we haven't
  classified (guards the silent "unknown → running" default).
- statusRead docstring: document the finished-but-not-stopped limitation — the
  WAT-67 entrypoint must self-stop on every exit path for the poller backstop.
- remove dead `_internal` export (no test referenced it).
- Dockerfile: unpin gh (apt repo serves only latest — `gh=<old>` is a build
  time-bomb); comment the COPY skills/ line so the DRAFT image is consistently
  not-yet-buildable alongside the WAT-67 entrypoint.

Full suite: 1750 green (Node 22).

Message:
feat(github-app): per-run repo-scoped installation token minter (WAT-65) (#30)

Adds a GitHub App installation token minter so the autonomous fixer
sandbox can obtain short-lived (~1h), single-repo credentials without
a per-user PAT.

New files:
  - src/integrations/github-app-client.js  — 3-step mint flow:
    (1) sign RS256 App JWT via Node crypto (no third-party JWT lib),
    (2) GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/installation → installation id,
    (3) POST /app/installations/{id}/access_tokens with bare repo name.
    Returns discriminated union: { ok:true, token, expiresAt } or
    { ok:false, reason:'app_not_installed' }. Non-404 errors propagate.
    All HTTP via retryableFetch (CJS mock-compatible).
  - add-github-app-credentials.js           — registration script.
  - tests/integrations/github-app-client.test.js  — 6 tests incl.
    real RSA-2048 keypair in all mint-flow scenarios, JWT structure +
    sig verification, and no-secrets-in-logs assertion.
  - tests/state/workspace-registry-app.test.js    — 6 round-trip +
    guard tests for the new registry methods.

Schema:
  - workspace-registry.js MIGRATIONS v5 adds 4 columns:
    github_app_id (plain text), github_app_key_{iv,auth_tag,encrypted}
    (AES-256-GCM). Includes bootstrapCheck for all 4 columns.
  - New exports: updateGithubAppCredentials, getGithubAppCredentials.

CLAUDE.md updated: Key Files table + credentials script list.

Operator prerequisites (outside this PR — real App must exist first):
  create GitHub App in org → generate private key (store in 1Password)
  → install App on target repos → run add-github-app-credentials.js.
